s: Paris (the capital and largest city of France)
Paris.et: From Middle High German Pārīs, from Old French Paris. The modern form follows non-diphthongising dialects, obviously reinforced by Modern French. The form Pareis still survives dialectally; compare also Luxembourgish Paräis, Dutch Parijs.
From Latin Paris, from Ancient Greek Πάρις (Páris).
